title: Hexcrow
summary: Milestone escrow using a stealth output, an approval path, a timeout refund and jointly signed mediator paths. The public invoice book records hashes, one-time keys, deadlines and status; role-specific copies disclose invoice text and amounts. November 4 review found that the website explicitly replays the archived October 29 run: the November 2 Esmeralda reset removed its template, book and transactions. The creator reports updated source using ootle-rs 0.31 and tari_template_lib 0.37 with 19 engine tests, while a replacement deployment is waiting for test funds. The refreshed recording switches public, client and accountant copies of the archived invoice; it performs no funding, wallet action or new transaction. Mediator judgment remains trusted, fees and timing remain visible, and the demo’s published throwaway keys must not hold value.
cardSummary: Replay confidential milestone invoices from public, client, contractor, mediator and accountant views to see who can read each detail.
